name: Serious Eats
notes: Main all-content feed (~4 posts/day, items from 2026-10-23/24). Heavy on gear roundups; keep items mentioning skillet, pan, Dutch oven, sear, steak, chicken, fish, soup, pasta, taco.

name: The Kitchn
notes: Very active, but lots of shopping/deal posts (Way Day, Amazon). Keep cookware reviews, skills showdowns and soup/braise recipes; drop furniture/organizer deals.

name: Bon Appétit
notes: Daily recipes plus gift guides and culture pieces; keep recipes and 'how to' stories, drop travel and politics.

name: Smitten Kitchen
notes: About 2 posts a month and nearly all keepers for weeknight home cooking (recent posts: chicken tacos, aglio e olio). No filter needed, though baking can be deprioritized.

name: Budget Bytes
notes: Several posts a week of simple soups, chicken and pasta. Keep soup/chicken/pasta/taco items; skip desserts and listicles.

name: RecipeTin Eats
notes: About 2 posts a week with very reliable technique-forward recipes (soups, ragù, schnitzel, fish). Skip desserts.

name: The Woks of Life
notes: Best source for carbon-steel wok stir-fries and noodle soups; 2–3 posts a week. Keep stir-fry/soup/noodle items.

name: NYT Food (Dining & Wine)
notes: Daily, mixed with restaurant news. Keep recipe and technique columns (stews, stocks, soup); drop reviews and NYC news. Some links are paywalled.

name: America's Test Kitchen (YouTube)
notes: Near-daily videos and Shorts, with equipment reviews and technique tests. Keep titles mentioning skillet, pan, Dutch oven, cast iron, steak, chicken, fish, rice; drop desserts.

name: Adam Ragusea (YouTube)
notes: Weekly home-cook technique and food-science videos (recent: lentil stews). Keep cooking videos; skip off-topic personal and lifting videos.

name: Reddit r/AskCulinary
notes: Hourly Q&A. High volume, so keep only posts mentioning pan, skillet, cast iron, carbon steel, stainless, sear, sauce, soup or steak.

name: Slickdeals Frontpage
notes: Live, many items an hour across all categories. Filter hard on All-Clad, Tramontina, Made In, Misen, Lodge, Smithey, Le Creuset, Staub, de Buyer, Matfer, skillet, Dutch oven, wok (e.g., a Tramontina tri-ply stock pot was on the frontpage 2026-10-24).
